name: Aurel
lore: A copper-scaled star dragon, small enough to fit through a town gate and old enough to remember when the sky was closer.

primary.name: Starfire Breath
primary.description: Breathe a narrow 24-degree stream of fire up to 170 units. Four ticks deal 4 damage each; hits refresh a burn for 1 damage per second over 3 seconds.

secondary.name: Wingbeat
secondary.description: Beat your wings to send an expanding gust around you: 18 damage, knockback and a one-second slow.

special.name: Skyfall Constellation
special.description: Trace a glowing constellation ahead of you. Seven telegraphed meteors fall in sequence, each exploding for 24 damage within 65 units.

passive: Afterglow: meteor explosions gain 12 units of radius.

technique.name: Needleflame
technique.description: Fire breath reaches 30% farther through a 35% narrower cone.

final_technique.name: Ember Talon
final_technique.description: Charge a piercing ember talon for 42 damage plus a small burn. Gives up Waterfall Wave’s circular push and slow.

attack.name: Ember Talon
attack.description: Charge a piercing ember talon for 42 damage plus a small burn. Gives up Waterfall Wave’s circular push and slow.
